answer_1.quote: This work focuses on the effects of segmentation in streaming ST, as cascade systems still outperform end-to-end systems in standard setups.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates translated text from speech input via a cascade of ASR and MT systems, where segmentation of ASR output is optimized to improve translation quality.

answer_2.quote: The quality of the MT output, in terms of BLEU score, provides a clear indication of the performance of the streaming ST segmenter and allows us to compare different segmenters.
